---
title: "Carica Record su Google Sheets"
format:
  html:
    include-after-body:
      - text: |
          <script src="record-form.js"></script>
---

```{=html}
<div class="container-fluid px-1 py-1">
<div class="row justify-content-center">
<div class="col-12 col-md-8 col-lg-6">

<div class="card border-0 rounded-3 mb-3">
<div class="card-header bg-primary text-white border-0 py-3">
<h5 class="mb-0"><i class="bi bi-file-earmark-spreadsheet"></i> Inserisci Dati</h5>
</div>

<div class="card-body p-3">
<form id="recordForm">
  <div class="mb-3">
    <label for="nome" class="form-label fw-semibold">Nome</label>
    <input type="text" class="form-control border-2" id="nome" placeholder="Il tuo nome" required>
  </div>
  
  <div class="mb-3">
    <label for="importo" class="form-label fw-semibold">Importo (€)</label>
    <input type="number" step="0.01" class="form-control border-2" id="importo" placeholder="0.00" required>
  </div>
  
  <div class="mb-3">
    <label for="nota" class="form-label fw-semibold">Nota</label>
    <textarea class="form-control border-2" id="nota" rows="3" placeholder="Aggiungi una nota" required></textarea>
  </div>
  
  <div class="d-grid">
    <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary btn-lg py-3">
      <i class="bi bi-send-fill"></i> Invia
    </button>
  </div>
</form>

<div id="message" class="mt-3"></div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="alert alert-info border-0 rounded-3" role="alert">
  <h6 class="alert-heading"><i class="bi bi-info-circle-fill"></i> Istruzioni</h6>
  <ol class="mb-0 ps-3">
    <li>Compila tutti i campi</li>
    <li>Premi Invia</li>
    <li>I dati saranno salvati automaticamente</li>
  </ol>
</div>

</div>
</div>
</div>
```
